blocking_reasons: No derived activation-field action, initial spectrum, or threshold.
No foundation energy balance or foundation-to-thermal transfer law.
No material-radiation EOS history or physical temperature history.
No atomic, stellar-clock, photon-flux, H_CC, or D_L forward model.
No CMB, recombination, BBN, supernova, BAO, or JWST validation.
claim: The finite-birth RefG dictionary is internally consistent and exactly identifies its physical, thermal, and observational closure boundary.

activation_scope.same_null_condition: Phi_t+(c0 p^2/a)Phi_chi=0 must follow from a PDE

conditional_front_crosscheck.assumptions: constant E, spherical V, same-null threshold, q=d ln(a)/d ln(P_F), D=1+3q
conditional_front_crosscheck.p_equals_one_boundary: checked exactly: the positive gap is D_gap/[c0(1+D_gap)]

thermal_source_history.sign_proof: exp(-J_e) is strictly decreasing because its derivative is -exp(-J_e)<0 and its value at J_e=0 is 1

contract.ASSUMPTIONS: Finite t-origin; positive p; p^2=P_F/P_F0; d_tau=p dt; A=a/p; global centerless birth; differentiable local threshold; P_F and P_th independent; conditional radiation EOS; local flat spherical continuity ledger with a regular center.
contract.BENCHMARK: Exact metric, threshold, energy, thermal, origin, and constant-D checks plus fail-fast negative mutations.
contract.CLAIM: The finite-birth RefG dictionary is internally consistent and exactly identifies its physical, thermal, and observational closure boundary.

CONVENTIONS.activation_radius: local threshold scale, not cosmic edge
CONVENTIONS.moving_boundary_radius: local flat physical Eulerian radius; F_0=0 regular center
CONVENTIONS.source_signs: J_b>0 outward; R_dot and Q_V signed; Q>0 foundation-to-thermal; Q_gamma>0 radiation injection; Pi_F>0 pressure
CONVENTIONS.units: c0: speed; P and rho: energy/volume; J_b: signed energy flux/area; Q_V: signed energy-rate per solid angle

contract.CROSSCHECK: general beta antiderivative; beta=1/2,1,3/2; constant-D beta=3/8 interval; moving boundary; two thermal states at fixed cadence.
contract.DEPENDENCIES: None. This self-contained gate derives dictionary/continuity consequences and checks labeled assumption-consequence branches.
contract.DOMAIN: t in (0,T0], positive differentiable background functions, nonzero threshold gradient, local flat Eulerian boundary patch, equilibrium radiation branch.
contract.ERROR_BOUND: Zero for symbolic identities; N/A otherwise.
contract.FAIL_CONDITION: Any identity/schema/mutation fails or an unclosed numerical temperature, age, H_CC, D_L, or birth model is promoted.
contract.FALSIFIER: A counterexample under frozen assumptions falsifies the exact identity; no RefG-wide falsifier is defined here.
contract.FORWARD_MODEL: N/A: no synthetic observable or real-data fit.

MODEL_VERSION.change_boundary: Any change to the finite origin, cadence-pressure bridge, scale split, threshold/moving-boundary/thermal domain, observable definitions, claim scope, or closure keys.

contract.PASS_CONDITION: All exact flags and mutations pass; schema is exact; every physical/observational closure remains false.

identities.common_cadence_cancellation: Gamma_t/H_t=Gamma_tau/H_tau; int Gamma_t dt=int Gamma_tau d_tau
identities.conditional_front_assumption_consequence: assume constant E, spherical V, and a same-null front; with q=d ln(a)/d ln(P_F), D=1+3q: D(R)dR/dt=c0 p^2 and d_tau/dR=D(R)/(c0 p)
identities.finite_birth: tau_0=int_0^T0 p(t)dt; finite iff p is integrable at t=0
identities.moving_boundary_energy: local conservation plus Leibniz/FTC, with regular center F_0=0, gives dE_act/dt=4pi[R^2(rho_b R_dot-J_b)+Q_V]
identities.moving_boundary_general_center: before the regular-center specialization, add +4pi F_0
identities.simultaneous_scale_evolution: a_dot>0 and p_dot<0 both contribute positively to H_A^(tau)=p^-1(a_dot/a-p_dot/p)
identities.volume_measure: V_F/V_op=p^3 for the same active cells
